verdict.rationale: Mastra provides documented suspend/resume functionality specifically for pausing workflows to 'request human-in-the-loop input' or await approval before resuming, which can be applied to gate specific tool calls before execution. This is a first-party documented feature rather than a workaround. Missing for 10: no hands-on/independent confirmation of gating a specific 'sensitive' tool call in practice, and no example showing per-tool-call granularity vs whole-workflow suspension.
